designationHistory.indexText: Our History President Benjamin Harrison established the Afognak Forest and Fish Culture Reserve in Alaska in 1892, principally for the conservation of sockeye salmon.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
